flyer.justification: The draft captures the core theme well with appropriate logistics placeholders, but the title exceeds the maximum limit of 6 words (8 words).

summary.justification: The summary is well-structured, adheres strictly to word count and section constraints, and covers the primary takeaways accurately.

instagram.justification: The post adheres to all requirements, including carousel cues, emojis, call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

linkedin.justification: The draft avoids prohibited buzzwords/clichés, features an engaging hook and discussion question, and includes 5 relevant hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows the editorial format with a subject line under 50 characters, three distinct bold subheadings, and a clear call to action.

blog.justification: The blog post is well-organized with numbered insight sections, an analytical comparison table, conclusion, and an Author profile section.
